spacer_convention: strictly intervening nucleotides, excluding both recognition pieces
occurrences: all overlapping single-piece starts; every distinct valid two-piece start pair once
coverage_scope: original inserts and NEXT certified encoded contexts reported separately; no outcome-driven subset or threshold choice
substitution_scope: equal-length ACGT/U parent and mutant; exact changed positions
changed_support: at least one gained or lost valid pair identity; unchanged net pair count can still represent turnover
edit_contact: a gained/lost pair must intersect at least one changed position within either recognition piece; spacer-only substitutions cannot change this exact sequence/spacing rule
models_or_labels: none; no fitting, score direction assignment, localization-effect read or outcome gate
not_claimed: IGF2BP1 activity in all assayed cells
